description:
Ha-Yun, who was struggling on his own, rescued a Persian cat who got almost hit by a car.
It was a good deed without any special intention, but the cat brought along a long-haired woman lying naked in front of his house.
Ha-Yun misunderstood her as a fan and tried to kick her out. However, she insisted that she was the guardian angel and persisted to stay around Ha-Yun.
She speaks and acts very differently from ordinary people.
Due to a weird situation, Ha-Yun is forced to hire her as a manager and live together. Also with blue, the cat that brought her along.
But the more he looks at this woman, the more vague it becomes. Is she really... an angel?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
